meta.description: Learn about S&PA — founded in 2014 to deliver quality MEP contracting, facility management, and ICT infrastructure across Egypt.

hero.title: Who We Are
hero.description: A specialized engineering company built on quality, certified systems, and long-term client partnership.

about.title: Engineering excellence since 2014
about.text: S&PA was founded in 2014 by experienced engineers in the passive fire protection industry. With a commitment to every aspect of quality, our main objective has always been customer satisfaction. We design, supply, install, and maintain electro-mechanical works — delivering MEP contracting, facility management, and ICT infrastructure with globally recognized products and certified processes.

mission.title: Delivering reliable engineering with lasting value
mission.text: To design, supply, install, and maintain electro-mechanical solutions that meet client needs within budget — through certified quality systems, skilled teams, and globally recognized products.

vision.title: Leading MEP excellence across Egypt
vision.text: To be the preferred engineering partner for MEP contracting, facility management, and ICT infrastructure — known for safety, innovation, and customer satisfaction on every project.

iso.title: Certifications
iso.description: We proudly hold ISO 9001, 14001 & 45001 certifications — internationally recognised standards that ensure we meet client needs through an effective quality management system.
iso.bannerText: International standards behind every project we deliver.
iso.iso9001Desc: Consistent processes that keep delivery reliable and client-focused.
iso.iso14001Desc: Responsible practices that reduce impact across our operations.
iso.iso45001Desc: Protecting people and sites with certified safety systems.

whatWeDo.title: From concept to lasting performance
whatWeDo.description: A complete delivery cycle that keeps every project safe, efficient, and aligned with client goals.
whatWeDo.item1Desc: Engineering design and coordination that balance performance, safety, and practical site execution.
whatWeDo.item2Desc: Sourcing globally recognized products and materials that deliver clear advantages on every project.
whatWeDo.item3Desc: Professional installation by certified teams across MEP, facility, and ICT infrastructure works.
whatWeDo.item4Desc: Ongoing maintenance and support that protect assets and keep facilities running with confidence.

cta.title: Meet the engineers behind every project
cta.description: Discover the specialists who design, install, and support complex MEP and safety configurations.
